comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, wages-and-r1099-single recoded as a box 7 code C Form 1099-R (a reportable death benefit under IRC 6050Y; box 1 = box 2a = 10,000) with a date in box 13, acquired in a reportable policy sale, 6,000 paid for the policy in total — IRC 101(a)(3)(A) makes the 101(a)(2) basis cap unconditional, so 4,000 is taxable on line 5b; line 24 = 4,145.00 (4,865.00 before box 13 was asked).
